summary.intent: Fix the injection tab in the memory loop TUI to test against all active memories and show whether each would be injected or not, instead of showing raw scores. Then remove skill, insights, improve, and permissions commands, keeping only summary and memory-loop.
summary.outcome: The injection tab was updated to use PreviewSelection() instead of SelectRelevant(), showing INJECT/SKIP labels with skip reasons for each memory. Two new tests were added and all 22 tests pass. The commit was made. The command removal task was planned but not yet executed.

repo: PreviewSelection() returns a SelectionReport with both Matches and Skipped fields, while SelectRelevant() only returns matched memories — PreviewSelection is the right API for showing full injection decisions
The memorylooptui package has a testPromptResultMsg that carries results from the prompt tester; it was extended to carry a full SelectionReport
explanatory_insights.go is a hook handler, not a command — it must be preserved when removing commands
Commands to remove: skill (skilldb/ + skilltui/ dirs), insights (insights/ dir), improve, permissions (permissions/ dir)

code.finding: testPromptResultMsg was changed to carry a SelectionReport instead of just a slice of matches
Switched from SelectRelevant() to PreviewSelection() to get full match+skip report
View updated to show summary line ('N would inject, M skipped'), INJECT label for matched memories, SKIP label with reason for skipped memories
unusedwrite lint fired on activeTab field assignments in tests that call injectionTab.view() directly — fix was to remove those assignments
This is a hook handler not a command and should be kept when removing the insights command

workflow: When a test assertion for 'not contains' fails because the target string is a substring of an unrelated section header, the assertion needs to be more specific
unusedwrite lint fires when test code sets a struct field but only calls a method that doesn't read it — remove the unused assignment rather than suppress

friction: Empty state test initially failed because 'INJECT' appeared as a substring in 'RECENT INJECTIONS' section header — required fixing the assertion
User interrupted the plan mode exit twice before implementation began, requiring a 'continue' prompt
Plan was written twice (once before user added the 'show inject/skip status' requirement, once after)
